def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    center_r = sum(r for r, c in points) / len(points)
    center_c = sum(c for r, c in points) / len(points)
    for r, c in points:
        color = grid[r][c]
        for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
            r2, c2 = r + dr, c + dc
            if not (0 <= r2 < h and 0 <= c2 < w and grid[r2][c2] == color):
                continue
            d1 = (r-center_r)**2 + (c-center_c)**2
            d2 = (r2-center_r)**2 + (c2-center_c)**2
            if d1 >= d2:
                rr, cc = r-dr, c-dc
                sr, sc = -dr, -dc
            else:
                rr, cc = r2+dr, c2+dc
                sr, sc = dr, dc
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                if out[rr][cc] == bg:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += sr
                cc += sc
    return out
